card.fires_on: Short word-like openings of a name or compound, such as Hat in Hatuka, Map in MapQuest or MapGuide, and map in maprotiline. The word is cut off, and the rest of the name comes next.

card.writes: It promotes word endings like maker, makers and wearer, so it favors a name or compound being completed.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a name like Hatuka, MapQuest or maprotiline, when the name is only half written.
